    unsafe fn record_gpu_cull(
        &self,
        cmd: vk::CommandBuffer,
        fi: usize,
        object_count: u32,
        hiz_enabled: bool,
        global_ubo_offset: u32,
        object_ssbo_offset: u32,
        instance_group_offset: u32,
        instance_member_offset: u32,
    ) {
        let total_groups = self.instance_gpu_groups.len() as u32;

        // ── Zero visibility buffer + instance counters ──────────
        self.device.cmd_fill_buffer(
            cmd, self.visibility_buffer.buffer,
            0, std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64 * object_count as u64,
            0,
        );
        self.device.cmd_fill_buffer(
            cmd, self.instance_counter_buffer.buffer,
            0, INSTANCE_COUNTER_BUFFER_SIZE,
            0,
        );

        // Barrier: fill → compute.
        {
            let barriers = [
                vk::BufferMemoryBarrier::default()
                    .buffer(self.visibility_buffer.buffer)
                    .offset(0)
                    .size(std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64 * object_count as u64)
                    .src_access_mask(vk::AccessFlags::TRANSFER_WRITE)
                    .dst_access_mask(vk::AccessFlags::SHADER_WRITE),
                vk::BufferMemoryBarrier::default()
                    .buffer(self.instance_counter_buffer.buffer)
                    .offset(0).size(INSTANCE_COUNTER_BUFFER_SIZE)
